title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineering Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Team   SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.  Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.  Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.  What You Will Do   Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.   Lead cross-team initiatives:   Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.   Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.   Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.   Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.   Drive roadmap and execution:  Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.   Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).   Establish engineering excellence:   Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.   Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.   Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.   Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.   Champion security and compliance by design:   Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.   Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.   Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.   Partner with the Architects:  Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.   Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.   Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.   Own delivery outcomes:  Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.   Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.   Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.   Operate a healthy on-call:  High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).   Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.   Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.   Initiatives You Will Lead:   Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.   AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.   Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).   Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.   Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.   Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.   Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.   Success Metrics   Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.   Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.   Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.   Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.   Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.   SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).   What You Will Bring   Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.   Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.   Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.   Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.   Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.   Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.   Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).   Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.   What You’ll Need   Advanced skills in English   Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.   Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).   Database performance engineering and query optimization.   Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.   FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).   How We Work   Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.   Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.   Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.   Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.   Tech Environment   Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).  Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).  Azure DevOps for CI/CD.  CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).  Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.  Caches: Redis.  Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.  Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.  Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

Nova vaga disponível para Product Owner em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! ✨ Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas. Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real. Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):  Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:  1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)  Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica  Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)  Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)  Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Diferencial Competitivo  IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. PARA ISSO, OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ TRABALHAR CONOSCO:  01) Salário: A combinar (Enviar pretensão salarial) 02 Segunda a Sexta 03) Horário: 08h às 17h 04) Local de trabalho: Prédio Sky Galleria (no Shopping Galleria), na Cidade de Campinas/SP 05) Regime de trabalho: HÍBRIDO (seguindo os critérios da política interna) 06) Regime de contratação: CLT 07) Plano de carreira 08) Cesta básica R$250,00 09) Vale refeição no total de R$ 32,00/ dia 10) Vale transporte c/ desconto 6%, pago em dinheiro ou Auxilio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00 11) Benefícios de VR, Cesta e Auxilio combustível, pagos através de um cartão unificado e flexível, operadora pela Sólides, para utilização na modalidade de crédito, bandeira Mastercard e que é aceito em uma infinidade de estabelecimentos 12) Convênio Farmácia,que conta com ofertas exclusivas e crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha de pagamento 13) Confraternizações: última quarta-feira (COFFEE BREAK) do mês 14) Parceria com Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo Cogna 15) Descontos em lojas e restaurantes do Galleria Shopping 16) Estacionamento do shopping com valor reduzido, pago mensalmente diretamente à administração Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

title: SDR
description:

SDR (Inbound & Outbound)  Mobiis  Campinas, São Paulo, Brasil  Sobre a Mobiis  A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar a inovação na cadeia logística. Resultado da união entre Fretefy e Pathfind, a empresa oferece tecnologias avançadas como TMS, Marketplace de Fretes e APIs, ajudando clientes e parceiros a otimizarem seus processos logísticos com mais inteligência e escala. Resumo da função  O SDR (Inbound & Outbound) será responsável por atuar na prospecção ativa e no atendimento de leads inbound, qualificando oportunidades para as soluções SaaS da Mobiis. Seu papel é identificar dores, entender o contexto do prospect, gerar interesse e agendar reuniões ou demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas, mantendo um funil de pré-vendas saudável e previsível. Principais responsabilidades  Atuar tanto em outbound  (ligações ativas, cadências e prospecção) quanto em inbound  (leads vindos de marketing, eventos, formulários e outros canais). Qualificar leads e prospects, entendendo necessidades, desafios, orçamento, perfil decisor e timing. Realizar abordagens consultivas, apresentando de forma objetiva as soluções da Mobiis. Agendar reuniões e demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas (closers / executivos de conta). Realizar follow-ups estratégicos ao longo do ciclo inicial de pré-vendas. Registrar e atualizar todas as interações no CRM, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Marketing e Vendas para melhoria contínua de scripts, discursos e campanhas. Atingir metas mensais de leads qualificados e reuniões agendadas.  Requisitos obrigatórios  Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales ou funções similares, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e resiliência a objeções. Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a processos e metas. Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e rotina de pré-vendas. Interesse e facilidade para aprender sobre soluções tecnológicas.  Requisitos desejáveis  Experiência com modelos de vendas inbound e outbound. Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou logística. Conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos. Inglês intermediário. Capacidade de adaptação a metas desafiadoras e ambientes de rápido crescimento.

title: Analista de dados
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista de dados em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Analista de Dados — Perfil e Risco   Sobre a Cooperlink A Cooperlink é uma associação de proteção patrimonial mutualista que atua na proteção veicular, oferecendo aos seus associados um modelo cooperativo de rateio de prejuízos como alternativa ao seguro tradicional. Operamos com tecnologia própria, integração direta entre CRM, sistema de gestão e canais de atendimento, e uma cultura orientada a dados — onde cada decisão de produto, comercial e operacional passa pela análise de carteira, perfil de associado e exposição a risco. Nosso time de dados atua de forma transversal, com acesso direto à diretoria e impacto real nas definições estratégicas da cooperativa. Resumo da posição Profissional responsável por transformar dados de associados/segurados, apólices, sinistros e canais em análises que orientem decisões de subscrição, pricing, retenção e mitigação de risco. Atua como ponte entre as áreas técnica, comercial e operacional, traduzindo comportamento e exposição em indicadores acionáveis. Principais responsabilidades  Construir e manter análises de perfil de carteira (associados, veículos, regiões, canais) identificando padrões de comportamento, consumo e propensão a sinistro. Desenvolver indicadores de risco: sinistralidade, frequência, severidade, prêmio médio, índice combinado e desvios por segmento. Apoiar a área de subscrição/underwriting com estudos de aceitação, recusa e precificação por faixa de risco. Realizar análises de churn, inadimplência e propensão à renovação, propondo ações de retenção baseadas em dados. Estruturar segmentações de carteira (clusterização por perfil de risco, ticket, vínculo, geografia). Monitorar carteira ativa: alertas de deterioração de sinistralidade, concentração de risco e desvios de meta. Construir dashboards executivos e operacionais em Power BI (ou equivalente) com camada semântica bem modelada. Criar e manter pipelines de dados em parceria com engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, consistência e rastreabilidade. Documentar regras de negócio, dicionário de dados e metodologias de cálculo dos indicadores de risco. Atender demandas ad hoc de diretoria, atuária, comercial e financeiro com agilidade e clareza.  Requisitos obrigatórios  Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Analista de Dados/BI, sendo pelo menos 1 ano no mercado segurador, de proteção patrimonial mutualista, saúde, previdência ou crédito. SQL avançado (joins complexos, CTEs, window functions, otimização de consultas). Power BI avançado: modelagem em estrela, DAX (medidas, time intelligence, variáveis), Power Query/M. Excel avançado, incluindo Power Query e estruturação de relatórios analíticos. Familiaridade com indicadores de seguro: sinistralidade, prêmio médio, frequência, severidade, índice combinado, LTV, CAC. Conhecimento de segmentação, análise de coorte e fundamentos de estatística descritiva. Boa comunicação para apresentar análises a públicos técnicos e não técnicos.  Diferenciais  Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) ou R para análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos. Experiência com Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake. Vivência em modelos de propensão (churn, sinistro, fraude) ou clusterização (K-Means, DBSCAN). Conhecimento de LGPD aplicado a dados sensíveis de clientes. Familiaridade com APIs de sistemas de gestão securitária (Hinova/SGA, Tex, Quiver, Sami) ou CRMs do setor. Noções de atuária básica e cálculo de provisões. Experiência com Git e versionamento de relatórios/scripts.  Perfil comportamental  Autonomia para investigar problemas de dados sem precisar de roteiro. Pensamento crítico — questiona o número antes de entregar. Postura consultiva: traduz pergunta de negócio em análise, não espera escopo pronto. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas.  Benefícios  (Salário compatível com senioridade · VR/VA · Plano de Saúde · TotalPass · Bolsa e Auxílio Educação)

description:

Demonstrated ability to be proactive and lead cross-functional teams.  • Willingness to travel.  Travel Requirements   • Approximately 5% - 10% Travel required – Mostly related to trade shows, conferences, or dealer visits. description:

Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.   Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.    What You Will Do     Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.     Lead cross-team initiatives:     Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.     Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.     Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.     Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.     Drive roadmap and execution:    Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.     Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).     Establish engineering excellence:     Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.     Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.     Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.     Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.     Champion security and compliance by design:     Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.     Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.     Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.     Partner with the Architects:    Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.     Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.     Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.     Own delivery outcomes:    Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.     Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.     Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real.  2. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente.   Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico.  3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)   Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)   Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias.   Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Benefits:   - 100% remote work.  - Flexible hours - make your own schedule! - Diverse and multicultural work environment.  - Paid parental leave, vacation & holidays.  - Hardware setup for you to work from home.  - Excellent compensation — well above the market average.  - Extensive opportunities for growth and professional development thanks to our mentoring system. If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de dados
description:

Analista de Dados — Perfil e Risco    Sobre a Cooperlink A Cooperlink é uma associação de proteção patrimonial mutualista que atua na proteção veicular, oferecendo aos seus associados um modelo cooperativo de rateio de prejuízos como alternativa ao seguro tradicional. Operamos com tecnologia própria, integração direta entre CRM, sistema de gestão e canais de atendimento, e uma cultura orientada a dados — onde cada decisão de produto, comercial e operacional passa pela análise de carteira, perfil de associado e exposição a risco. Nosso time de dados atua de forma transversal, com acesso direto à diretoria e impacto real nas definições estratégicas da cooperativa.   Resumo da posição Profissional responsável por transformar dados de associados/segurados, apólices, sinistros e canais em análises que orientem decisões de subscrição, pricing, retenção e mitigação de risco. Atua como ponte entre as áreas técnica, comercial e operacional, traduzindo comportamento e exposição em indicadores acionáveis.    Principais responsabilidades    Construir e manter análises de perfil de carteira (associados, veículos, regiões, canais) identificando padrões de comportamento, consumo e propensão a sinistro.   Desenvolver indicadores de risco: sinistralidade, frequência, severidade, prêmio médio, índice combinado e desvios por segmento.   Apoiar a área de subscrição/underwriting com estudos de aceitação, recusa e precificação por faixa de risco.   Realizar análises de churn, inadimplência e propensão à renovação, propondo ações de retenção baseadas em dados.   Estruturar segmentações de carteira (clusterização por perfil de risco, ticket, vínculo, geografia).   Monitorar carteira ativa: alertas de deterioração de sinistralidade, concentração de risco e desvios de meta.   Construir dashboards executivos e operacionais em Power BI (ou equivalente) com camada semântica bem modelada.   Criar e manter pipelines de dados em parceria com engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, consistência e rastreabilidade.   Documentar regras de negócio, dicionário de dados e metodologias de cálculo dos indicadores de risco.   Atender demandas ad hoc de diretoria, atuária, comercial e financeiro com agilidade e clareza.     Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Analista de Dados/BI, sendo pelo menos 1 ano no mercado segurador, de proteção patrimonial mutualista, saúde, previdência ou crédito.   SQL avançado (joins complexos, CTEs, window functions, otimização de consultas).   Power BI avançado: modelagem em estrela, DAX (medidas, time intelligence, variáveis), Power Query/M.   Excel avançado, incluindo Power Query e estruturação de relatórios analíticos.   Familiaridade com indicadores de seguro: sinistralidade, prêmio médio, frequência, severidade, índice combinado, LTV, CAC.   Conhecimento de segmentação, análise de coorte e fundamentos de estatística descritiva.   Boa comunicação para apresentar análises a públicos técnicos e não técnicos.     Diferenciais    Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) ou R para análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos.   Experiência com Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.   Vivência em modelos de propensão (churn, sinistro, fraude) ou clusterização (K-Means, DBSCAN).   Conhecimento de LGPD aplicado a dados sensíveis de clientes.   Familiaridade com APIs de sistemas de gestão securitária (Hinova/SGA, Tex, Quiver, Sami) ou CRMs do setor.   Noções de atuária básica e cálculo de provisões.   Experiência com Git e versionamento de relatórios/scripts.     Perfil comportamental    Autonomia para investigar problemas de dados sem precisar de roteiro.   Pensamento crítico — questiona o número antes de entregar.   Postura consultiva: traduz pergunta de negócio em análise, não espera escopo pronto.   Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas.     Benefícios   (Salário compatível com senioridade · VR/VA · Plano de Saúde · TotalPass · Bolsa e Auxílio Educação)

Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.  As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.   You Are Likely To Succeed If  You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools  to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)   What We Offer:  Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package  Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Clinical Study Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Summary  The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities   Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.  Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.  Education and Experience  Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.  Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.  Knowledge, Skills and Abilities  Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.). . Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

Desenvolvemos soluções de tecnologia que empoderam marcas, de assessorias de imprensa e agências de relações públicas a grandes empresas e governos. Somos uma empresa em forte expansão, com três rodadas de capital de risco realizadas (Oria Capital), cultura ágil e um time que acredita que tecnologia e pessoas transformam negócios de verdade. Essa é uma vaga para quem tem mentalidade de crescimento, visão de negócio e sabe construir relações consultivas com decisores de comunicação e marketing em empresas de médio e grande porte. Vaga 100% remota - Home Office  Responsabilidades e atribuições  Atuar no ciclo completo de vendas: da qualificação ao fechamento, com contas Mid Market e Enterprise; Trabalhar leads qualificados gerados pelo Marketing (inbound), com foco em conversão eficiente; Executar prospecção outbound ativa, mapeando contas estratégicas, personalizando abordagens e gerando pipeline próprio; Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes atual, em parceria com o time de Customer Success; Conduzir apresentações e demos consultivas das soluções Knewin, adaptando o discurso ao contexto e às dores de cada cliente; Construir e manter relacionamento sólido com múltiplos stakeholders (comunicação, marketing, C-level); Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil; Manter o CRM (HubSpot) atualizado com precisão e disciplina, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline; Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e conduzir negociações complexas; Colaborar ativamente com Marketing, CS e RevOps para otimizar conversão e reduzir churn.  Requisitos e qualificações  Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B SaaS, com ciclos de venda consultivos e tickets médios/altos; Experiência com contas Mid Market ou Enterprise; Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound; Experiência com vendas consultivas; Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores; Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, HubSpot é diferencial; Ensino superior completo.  Também é legal se você tiver:  Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia; Familiaridade com HubSpot. Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte; Experiência com ferramentas de prospecção e automação (ex: Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator); Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências de PR e assessorias de imprensa;  O que oferecemos:  Trabalho 100% remoto - Home Office; Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance; Pacote de benefícios Knewin; Produto consolidado com cases relevantes no mercado; Time comercial estruturado com suporte de Marketing, RevOps e CS; Ambiente dinâmico, flexível e com autonomia real; Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em fase de expansão acelerada.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview  Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities  Business Process Engineering  (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.  Automation, Integration & AI Implementation  Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.  IT Administration & Security  Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.  Required Qualifications & Skills  Technical Experience:  5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.  Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:  Communication:  Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:  Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making:  Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.  Benefits & Compensation  Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Confira a oportunidade para Front End Technical lead-AI em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Technical Lead, AI and Engineering 100% Remote LATAM   This is a combination of Lead, Front end - React and Next JS hands on development, and Generative AI Candidates should have been at a Lead capacity overseeing multiple projects. They could be a people manager as well - but should be hands on with development   Candidates have to clear React Hacker Rank coding test   Our client is building a scalable, AI-enabled platform that helps founders turn ideas into real ventures. As a Tech Lead, you’ll play a key role in shaping the core architecture and AI infrastructure, with real ownership over how the platform is designed, built, and scaled. Job Description  Job Summary:  Lead development and implementation of complex information technology projects and architecture to solve problems with wide impact, requiring high levels of functional integration. The Technical Lead acts as the primary architectural authority and engineering manager for the platform. This hands-on role is responsible for architecting scalable technical solutions, managing the engineering team, and working closely with the Product Team and Business Leadership to build AI-powered tools that deliver measurable value. Job-Specific Responsibilities:  Technical Architecture & Strategy  Architect, design, and provide hands-on contribution to the development and deployment of scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions that support business goals and product initiatives. Make technical design choices and follow technical standards, including cyber security, software languages, tools, and infrastructure. Balance fast, lean innovation with practical implementation, technical feasibility, technical debt, and system stability in production environments. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their applicability to platform needs and understand risk mitigation strategies.  Engineering Leadership & Priorities  Manage the engineering team in alignment with product roadmap and critical deadlines. Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical specs and engineering tasks. Mentor software developers, conduct code reviews, and ensure high-quality coding. Oversee the software product development lifecycle, including MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and release management, as well as data pipelines, and governance.  Product Collaboration  Partner with the Product Team, Designers, and Business Director to align on strategic priorities, estimate development effort, and define timelines. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders including executives and customers.  Ethics & Risk Management  Ensure responsible data management and AI practices (fairness, transparency, and data privacy) and ensure governance frameworks for AI model deployment and monitoring. Navigate regulatory requirements, security needs, and compliance consideration.  Other Responsibilities:  Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents. This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.  Qualifications  Basic Qualifications:  Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience  Additional Required Qualifications:  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field 8+ years of Software Engineering (ideally AI-focused) experience, including 2+ years in a Lead Engineer, Architect, or equivalent technical leadership role  Core Technical Expertise:   Deep understanding of and strong hands-on experience with: Application & Product Engineering  Modern web application architecture, including frontend, middleware, backend, and full-stack development Languages and frameworks including Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, NextJS, React, Node.js, and SQL  APIs, Services & Data  Microservices and API design, including REST and GraphQL Asynchronous and event-driven systems Authentication and authorization Data and storage systems (relational, NoSQL, and vector databases) Cloud Platforms & Infrastructure  Cloud-native and distributed systems design Containerization and orchestration (e.g., Terraform, Docker) AWS , including Bedrock, SageMaker, EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, and IAM Additional cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) and cloud-agnostic design principles DevOps, MLOps & Delivery  CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code Model deployment, monitoring, and operational reliability AI & LLM Systems  AI/ML tools and frameworks (e.g., LangGraph) and production-grade API integrations Design, deployment, and evaluation of LLM-powered systems, including prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures  If inteerested please connect me over the whats app no.   or reply through the mail.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Technical Product Owner em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

ABOUT US  Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE  We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do  Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.  WHAT IT TAKES  The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.  Key Skills  Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.  Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.  OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio. Responsabilidades:  Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.  Requisitos necessários  Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.  Diferenciais  Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.  Perfil esperado   Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.  #SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.  Buscamos alguém que apresente:  Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)  Conhecimento específicos:  Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança  Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Informações da vaga:  Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:  • Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times; • Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas; • Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo; • Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas; • Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade; • Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!  Saúde e Bem-estar:  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família; • Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina; • Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras; • Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional; • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas; • Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida. Proteção e estabilidade:  • Previdência privada; • Participação nos lucros; • Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia:  • Vale-Alimentação; • Vale-Refeição; • Vale-Transporte; • Auxílio-Creche; • Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação:  • Plataforma de ensino; • Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições. Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.  Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.   Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos.. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines;  Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices. title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager  Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.  This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.  What you’ll do: • Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more • Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where • Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms • Help shape the voice and presence of brands online • Analyze performance and double down on what works Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.) Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips  2. Podcast Clip Strategy Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan  Decide what clips get posted, when, and where  Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)  3. Growth & Optimization Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase: Views Engagement Follower growth A/B test captions, formats, and posting times  4. Platform Expertise Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)  5. Systems & Organization Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system  Track posted content and performance metrics Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting  6. Collaboration Work closely with: Editors (to refine clips) Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals) Leadership (to align on growth strategy)  What we’re looking for: • Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video) • Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts • Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior • Ability to manage both content output + community interaction  Must-Haves 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content) Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video  Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts Strong instincts for what makes content go viral  Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day) Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing.   Nice-to-Haves Experience working with podcasts or long-form content Background in content editing or scripting Familiarity with tools like: Asana/ Slack Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.) Analytics tools Experience managing multiple brands or clients  Bonus: • Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands • Background in content editing or scripting • Experience building or managing online communities This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NatureCo  NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.  Role and responsibilities  The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include:  Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management  Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.  Eligibility, due diligence & agreements  Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system  (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement  Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).  Stakeholder engagement and safeguards  Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.  Reporting  Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.  Teamwork and culture  Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.  Skills and attributes  To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.  Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.  Location  Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia  Submission instructions  Email CV and brief cover letter to  with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026
