title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista de dados sênior em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a DataEX:  Com 12 anos de atuação  no mercado, a DataEX  é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.  Contexto:  Busca-se profissional para atuação como Analista de Dados Sênior  em projetos estratégicos, com forte capacidade analítica, visão de negócio e profundo domínio de Power BI / Fabric , apto a atuar de ponta a ponta em iniciativas analíticas complexas, influenciando decisões estratégicas e apoiando o desenvolvimento do time. Especialidades e domínio técnico em Power BI  DAX avançado : construção de métricas complexas, cálculo de KPIs, otimização de performance e boas práticas de escrita. Power Query : transformação, limpeza e integração de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes. Linguagem M : desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts avançados para ingestão e transformação de dados. Row-Level Security (RLS) : definição e implementação de regras de segurança e governança de acesso aos dados. Data Visualization (Dataviz) : criação de dashboards claros, intuitivos e orientados à tomada de decisão, aplicando princípios de storytelling e UX em dados. Modelagem semântica no Power BI : relacionamento entre tabelas, cardinalidade, direção de filtros e otimização do modelo.  Perfil técnico esperado  Sólida experiência em análise de dados e resolução de problemas complexos , com foco em geração de valor para o negócio. Atuação como referência técnica , com experiência em mentoria, revisão de entregas e evolução de analistas . Experiência na definição e implementação de estratégias analíticas , alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais. Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem dimensional  (Star Schema, Snowflake). Forte experiência no levantamento, entendimento e validação de requisitos de negócio , traduzindo necessidades em soluções analíticas escaláveis. Vivência com Big Data , incluindo consumo e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados. Experiência prática com Data Warehouses  . Experiência com Data Lakes / Lakehouses  (ex.: Onelake, Azure Data Lake, Databricks ou similares). Atuação em ambientes de nuvem  (Azure , AWS, ou similares). Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e influência , com capacidade de traduzir dados em insights estratégicos para diferentes públicos.  Escopo de atuação  Conduzir o levantamento, validação e refinamento dos requisitos de negócio  junto às áreas usuárias. Definir, validar e evoluir a modelagem dimensional  (conceitual, lógica e física). Liderar projetos analíticos end-to-end , da concepção à entrega e sustentação. Atuar em projeto de Migração para Power BI/Fabric Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de análise de dados e visualização  em Power BI. Atuar em parceria com líderes de negócio para identificar oportunidades de análise e melhoria de processos . Construir e apresentar dashboards, insights e recomendações executivas  para stakeholders. Garantir qualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados , promovendo boas práticas analíticas no time.

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Empresa está contratando Tech Lead Java em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Tech Lead Java  A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.    Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais  para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás  confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.   Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência . Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?   Qual será o seu papel? Você atuará como principal referência técnica de TI para o time e para o cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade das entregas, a evolução técnica da equipe e um ambiente colaborativo alinhado à cultura. Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento. Como será seu dia a dia? Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos; Acompanhar dinâmicas de equipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos; Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas; Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação; Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas; Resolver conflitos e manter um ambiente colaborativo, positivo e focado em resultados.  Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java , com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação); Domínio de Spring Boot , incluindo construção de APIs, segurança, persistência de dados e organização de aplicações escaláveis e de fácil manutenção; Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados  relacionais e NoSQL, com capacidade de modelagem, escrita de queries eficientes e entendimento de performance e uso adequado de cada tecnologia; Vivência com AWS , compreendendo o uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda no contexto de aplicações reais, incluindo deploy, configuração e monitoramento básico; Experiência com containers (Docker e/ou Kubernetes ), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados; Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful , seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança; Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git, incluindo colaboração em equipe, code review e organização de branches; Experiência com testes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue; Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe; Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.  Você pode se destacar se: Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD; Tiver vivência com desenvolvimento de arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis; Tiver conhecimento em ferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch.    Curtiu a oportunidade?  Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Ingeniero IaC — Terraform & Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

Sobre a VMetrix  A VMetrix é uma Fintech B2B que está transformando a forma como as instituições financeiras gerenciam investimentos, risco e tesouraria. Nossa plataforma SaaS Front to Back to Risk permite que bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e outras instituições financeiras implementem tecnologia de nível mundial em meses, não em anos, com um modelo flexível e escalável.  Operamos em múltiplos países e trabalhamos com organizações onde as decisões são tomadas por meio de comitês de compra, licitações e processos altamente rigorosos, em um ambiente onde confiança, reputação e certeza são determinantes.   O Papel  Você será o arquiteto e guardião da infraestrutura cloud da VMetrix. Automatizará, provisionará e gerenciará todos os recursos OCI por meio do Terraform, garantindo ambientes reproduzíveis, seguros e altamente disponíveis que sustentam nossa plataforma financeira crítica. Se você é Ex-Oracle ou Ex-OCI, esta vaga foi feita para você. Candidate-se sem hesitar.  Requisitos Eliminatórios - Sem exceção:  Experiência obrigatória  5+ anos em infraestrutura cloud (comprovável) 3+ años  trabalhando diretamente com Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) 5+ anos de domínio prático de Terraform (módulos, remote state, workspaces, backends) Graduação em Engenharia da Computação, Redes, Sistemas ou área correlata  OCI — Domínio técnico não negociável  Networking: VCN, subnets, Security Lists, NSGs, IGW, NAT GW, Service GW, DRG Compute: VMs, BM, instance pools, autoscaling, custom images Storage: Object Storage, Block Volumes, File Storage, Archive Storage Bancos de dados: Oracle DB 21c EE, Autonomous DB, MySQL HeatWave IAM: compartimentos, políticas, dynamic groups, instance principals OCI DevOps: Code Repos, Build Pipelines, Deployment Pipelines Observabilidade: OCI Monitoring, Logging, Notifications, Events  Terraform & IaC — Domínio avançado  Variables, outputs, módulos, remote state, terraform.tfvars, backends OCI Object Storage Gestão de múltiplos workspaces e ambientes (Dev / QA / Prod) Integração com CI/CD: OCI DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins ou GitHub Actions Git e GitFlow para versionamento de infraestrutura  Segurança Cloud  IAM policies, criptografia KMS/Vault, Audit Service no OCI Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), CIS Benchmarks para OCI Gestão de segredos: OCI Vault e/ou HashiCorp Vault  Perfil Diferencial — O que coloca você à frente:  Ex-funcionário ou ex-contratado da Oracle com experiência em suporte, implementação ou arquitetura OCI → MÁXIMO diferencial do processo  Portfólio comprovado em OCI + Terraform (repositórios Git públicos, artigos, open source) Experiência em migrações cloud-to-cloud ou on-premises para OCI Conhecimento de pricing e otimização de custos no OCI Conhecimento de Terragrunt, Ansible ou ferramentas de gerenciamento de configuração Containers: Docker e Kubernetes / OKE Contribuições à comunidade (blog, meetups, palestras sobre OCI ou Terraform)  Certificações - Altamente desejáveis:  OCI Architect Professional (1Z0-997) OCI DevOps Professional (1Z0-1109) OCI Security Professional (1Z0-1104) HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003)  Por que trabalhar na VMetrix  En VMetrix  não buscamos fazer “mais barulho”, mas construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relacionamentos de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, VMetrix  é o lugar certo. #OCI #Terraform #IaC #OracleCloud #CloudEngineering #LATAM #RemoteWork #VMetrix

Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms. Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams. Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies. Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions. Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.  Key Traits for Success  Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

You’ll be successful  in this role if you have : Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms  (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning  (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).  Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs  (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .  Why Join Us  You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:  Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Customer Success II para atuar na implantação (onboarding) de clientes da vertical de Capital Humano, com foco em execução de projetos, alinhamento entre stakeholders e geração de valor desde os primeiros marcos da jornada. Essa posição será responsável por conduzir projetos de onboarding com diferentes níveis de complexidade, garantindo organização, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade na entrega, mesmo em cenários fora do fluxo padrão. Procuramos um perfil com forte capacidade de execução, organização e relacionamento, que atue com protagonismo na condução dos projetos e tenha facilidade em navegar entre múltiplos stakeholders. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:  Conduzir o onboarding de clientes B2B, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas, clareza de escopo e cumprimento de prazos; Estruturar e gerenciar cronogramas de implantação, acompanhando entregas, dependências e riscos ao longo da jornada; Atuar como principal ponto de contato do cliente durante o onboarding, garantindo comunicação clara e acompanhamento contínuo; Conduzir reuniões de projeto (kickoff, checkpoints, treinamentos e follow-ups), assegurando evolução do cliente ao longo da jornada; Gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, mantendo organização e priorização das demandas; Identificar riscos, desvios e oportunidades de melhoria durante a execução, propondo planos de ação; Monitorar indicadores de sucesso como adoção, engajamento e satisfação do cliente; Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas (Produto, Suporte, Comercial), garantindo fluidez nas entregas; Garantir registros e acompanhamento estruturado das interações e demandas dos clientes; Contribuir com melhorias de processos, trazendo visão crítica e sugestões baseadas na operação.  O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:  Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Onboarding ou Atendimento ao Cliente B2B; Vivência prática com gestão de projetos (planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de cronogramas); Experiência com múltiplos stakeholders e condução de agendas estruturadas; Capacidade de organização e gestão de múltiplas demandas simultâneas; Boa leitura de indicadores e acompanhamento de performance do cliente; Conhecimento intermediário em ferramentas como GSuite ou Pacote Office. Comunicação executiva e influência; Organização e capacidade de priorização; Protagonismo e senso de dono; Escuta ativa e construção de relacionamento; Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica; Maturidade para atuação em cenários de pressão e negociação; Boa gestão de relacionamento com clientes e áreas internas.  INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS  Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média. A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados. E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente. Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma. Dito isso, oferecemos: ● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador; ● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais; ● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores; ● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria... ● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito; ● Plano de saúde e odontológico; ● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação; ● Vale transporte; ● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida; ● Espaço de lactário; ● Bicicletário; ● Vestiário; ● Seguro de vida; ● Auxílio creche; ● Previdência privada; ● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar; ● Gympass. Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc. #Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:

About the Opportunity  We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead  to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing. You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact. Responsibilities  Technical Leadership:  Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle. Architecture & Development:  Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications. System Optimization:  Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems. Complex Integrations:  Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications. Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions. Domain Ownership:  Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows. Quality & Documentation:  Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites. Full-Stack Oversight:  While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.  Required Qualifications  Proven Leadership:  Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment. Ruby on Rails Mastery:  12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework. Advanced API Expertise:  Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale. Testing & CI/CD:  Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage. Front-End Proficiency:  Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery). Education:  4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp. Language:  Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.  Nice to Have Skills  Go (Golang) Experience:  Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components. title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)  to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors. Key Responsibilities:  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties  Market & Network Development  Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred  Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global
description:

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss? Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look? Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems? Final question:  when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away? If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA  role. At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry. Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously. This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent. This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error. However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **  You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:  Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.  Key Responsibilities Include:  Campaign Audit & Validation  Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters  Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity  Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup  Budget & Pacing Verification  Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly  Tracking, Links & Technical QA  Verify accuracy and functionality of: URLs and landing pages UTM parameters and tracking links Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable) Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies  Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation  Compare campaign execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely  Audit Documentation & Communication  Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution  Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)  This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits  Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts  Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)  Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards  Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:  Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment  Preferred Experience:  Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)  Nice to Have:  Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment  Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):  Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) TikTok Ads LinkedIn Ads TradeDesk  Why Our Work Matters:  Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough. That’s where Crisp comes in. We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. About Crisp:   Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal. OUR BOOK:  The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)  OUR PODCAST:  The Game Changing Attorney Podcast  Why You Should Work Here:  You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues  This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations. This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **  You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:  Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.

Estamos em constante evolução e buscamos pessoas que queiram construir o futuro com a gente, com inovação, tecnologia, impacto real e foco no cliente. Responsabilidades e atribuições:   Ser o owner técnico de um domínio ou subsistema, garantindo evolução segura e saudável ao longo do tempo. Garantir que o domínio opere com SLOs acordados (latência/erros/disponibilidade) e trabalhar ativamente para melhorar a confiabilidade. Liderar planejamento técnico e execução do domínio: decomposição, dependências, riscos, execução e validação. Elevar consistentemente o nível técnico do time: boas práticas, revisão forte, referências, documentação e padrões. Ser referência técnica interna: apoiar decisões complexas, destravar discussões e reduzir retrabalho. Liderar resposta a incidentes do seu domínio: mitigação, RCA rigoroso e ações preventivas estruturais.  Requisitos e qualificações:   TypeScript + Node.js (async/await, promises, error handling; event loop, streams e concorrência). Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com OpenAPI (contratos, validação e status codes). SQL (Postgres): consultas, migrations, otimização de queries e índices. Git e fluxo de PRs (commits pequenos, rebase e resolução simples de conflitos). Testes automatizados (unitários, integração e contrato) com Jest. CI/CD e deploy: pipeline (lint/test/build/deploy), smoke tests, variáveis e logs. Observabilidade: logs estruturados, métricas básicas e tracing superficial. Mensageria e resiliência (BullMQ/RabbitMQ): retry, DLQ, idempotência e ordering quando necessário. Performance e escalabilidade: profiling, gargalos comuns e trade-offs. System design básico aplicado: rate limit, circuit breaker, bulkhead e degradação graciosa. Concorrência e integridade: locks e consistência (otimista/pessimista). Português fluente é necessário para comunicação local no Brasil.  5) Modelo de Trabalho Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação em desenvolvimento de negócios. title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Sr. AI Engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)  Please upload your CV Resume in English.  Monthly salary:  $5,000 - $6,500  USD Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real. The role:  They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director. This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application. What you’ll do:  Take prototypes to production.  The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users. Own AI engineering decisions.  Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills. Build full-stack.  Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed. Harden and deploy.  CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe. Close the loop with stakeholders.  Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it. Manage and extend the verified query set.  Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy. Close the feedback loop.  User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use. Work with AI agents.  Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.  Tech you’ll work with:  Application layer:  TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI. AI / LLM integration:  Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol) Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products. Data layer:  Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0 You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics. Infrastructure:  Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.  What they’re looking for:  Must-haves  AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems. You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully. Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI. Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real. Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people. AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system. AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty. Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.  Nice-to-haves:  Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics Snowflake / SQL analytics experience Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX Azure cloud platform experience LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime  How our partner works:  Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team. Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership. Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers. Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase. Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.  Benefits:  A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays.  *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Site Reliability Engineering Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About the Team  SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.   Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.   Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.   What You Will Do   Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.    Lead cross-team initiatives:    Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.    Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.    Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.    Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.    Drive roadmap and execution:   Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.    Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).    Establish engineering excellence:   Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.    Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.    Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.    Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.    Champion security and compliance by design:    Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.    Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.    Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.    Partner with the Architects:   Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.    Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.    Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.    Own delivery outcomes:   Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.    Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.    Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.    Operate a healthy on-call:   High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).    Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.    Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.    Initiatives You Will Lead:   Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.    AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.    Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).    Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.    Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.    Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.    Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.    Success Metrics   Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.    Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.    Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.    Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.    Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.    SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).    What You Will Bring   Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.    Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.    Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.    Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.    Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.    Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.    Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).    Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.    What You'll Need   Advanced skills in English    Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.    Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).    Database performance engineering and query optimization.    Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.    FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).    How We Work   Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.    Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.    Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.    Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.    Tech Environment   Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).   Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).   Azure DevOps for CI/CD.   CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).   Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.   Caches: Redis.   Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.   Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.   Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

Para qual empresa estamos trabalhando?   Maior franquia do Brasil em soluções de energia solar, a empresa é pioneira no setor em que atua. São mais de 470 franquias presentes em 26 estados, além do Distrito Federal, com sistemas fotovoltaicos instalados por todo o Brasil.  A empresa oferece soluções de energia solar fotovoltaica para clientes de pequeno, médio e grande porte e viabiliza o sonho de diminuir em até 98% o custo da energia elétrica. Ao optar por um sistema de energia solar, você declara a sua independência energética enquanto contribui para um planeta mais sustentável.  Além disso, a empresa promove um modelo de negócios de formato inovador e que oferece um know-how completo para os franqueados. O mercado de energia solar tem se expandido de maneira constante e, segundo estimativas do governo, a tendência é que esse setor movimente R$ 100 bilhões até 2030.  O que você irá fazer?    Executar e controlar rotinas financeiras de contas a pagar e contas a receber.  Gerenciar fluxo de caixa realizado e projetado, garantindo visibilidade da saúde financeira da empresa.  Acompanhar DRE, elaborar relatórios financeiros e indicadores para suporte à tomada de decisão.  Atuar como guardião do financeiro, com análise crítica de custos, despesas e oportunidades de otimização.  Apoiar o relacionamento com contabilidade externa, BPO e fornecedores.  Controlar recebíveis de franqueados, fornecedores e comissionamentos.  Preparar apresentações financeiras e relatórios executivos para diretoria e sócios.  Contribuir para a estruturação e melhoria de processos financeiros e automatizações no ERP.   O que você precisa ter?    Experiência sólida na área financeira, com atuação em rotinas operacionais e visão analítica.  Domínio de Excel em nível avançado e facilidade para análise de dados financeiros.  Conhecimento em fluxo de caixa, DRE, controle orçamentário e noções de contabilidade.  Perfil organizado, analítico e atento a detalhes.  Capacidade de comunicação para interação com franqueados, fornecedores e liderança.  Experiência com ERP financeiro (diferencial: Omie).   O que a empresa oferece?    Ambiente dinâmico, com alto grau de confiança e impacto direto nos resultados do negócio.  Autonomia e protagonismo na estruturação do financeiro da empresa.  Atuação direta com a liderança e participação em decisões estratégicas.   Informações adicionais    Modelo de contrato: PJ  Modelo de atuação: presencial  Local: Campinas-SP
